Product Overview:

Fromaggio is a groundbreaking, first to market kitchen appliance that brings the ancient art of cheesemaking into the 21st century. Designed for both novices and cheese aficionados alike, Fromaggio simplifies the process, allowing you to craft delicious, high-quality cheese from the comfort of your home.

Features and Benefits:

Automated Process: Easy-to-use settings for making a wide range of cheeses, from mozzarella to feta, at the push of a button.

Customizable Recipes: Adjust settings in the mobile app to create your own unique cheeses according to your taste, diet and budget.

High-Quality Materials: Constructed with food-safe, durable materials ensuring longevity and safety.

Smart Connectivity: Manage your cheesemaking process through our app, access a wide variety of recipes from Fromaggio and other users globally. Create your own custom recipes.

Compact Design: Sleek and stylish, it fits perfectly on any kitchen countertop. Copper and Stainless steel versions.

Eco-Friendly: Make cheese using natural ingredients with less waste and packaging.

🧀 Fromaggio Affiliate Program Terms & Code of Conduct

Welcome to the Fromaggio Affiliate Program! Our mission is to build a community of passionate advocates who genuinely love and promote our products. To maintain the integrity of our brand and ensure a positive experience for all, affiliates must adhere to the following terms:

1. Prohibited Advertising Practices

  • No Paid Advertising: Affiliates are strictly prohibited from running any form of paid advertising (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads) that uses Fromaggio's brand name, trademarks, or related keywords. This includes bidding on branded terms or creating ads that compete with Fromaggio's official campaigns.​

  • No Trademark Bidding: Using Fromaggio's trademarks or brand names in any paid search engine marketing is not allowed.​

  • No Unauthorized Promotions: Affiliates must not promote Fromaggio through unauthorized channels or platforms that have not been approved by Fromaggio.​

2. Unethical and Fraudulent Activities

  • No Cookie Stuffing: Affiliates must not use techniques that automatically set affiliate cookies without the user's knowledge, such as pop-ups or hidden iframes.​

  • No Misleading Content: All promotional content must be honest and not contain false or exaggerated claims about Fromaggio products.​

  • No Adware or Spyware: Affiliates must not use software that hijacks traffic, displays unauthorized ads, or collects user data without consent.​

  • No Trademark Infringement: Using Fromaggio's logos, images, or other intellectual property without permission is strictly prohibited.​

3. Approved Promotional Methods

We encourage affiliates to promote Fromaggio through authentic and creative means:

  • Content Creation: Write blog posts, create videos, or develop tutorials that showcase your genuine experience with Fromaggio products.​

  • Social Media Engagement: Share your Fromaggio journey on platforms like Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest. Use your unique voice to connect with your audience.​

  • Community Building: Engage with your community through forums, newsletters, or local events to spread the word about Fromaggio.​

  • Email Marketing: Send informative and value-driven emails to your subscribers, ensuring compliance with anti-spam laws and including necessary disclaimers.​

4. Transparency and Disclosure

  • Clear Disclosures: Affiliates must clearly disclose their relationship with Fromaggio in all promotional content, as required by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and other regulatory bodies.​

  • Honest Endorsements: Only promote Fromaggio products you have personally used and genuinely endorse.​

5. Compliance and Enforcement

  • Monitoring: Fromaggio reserves the right to monitor affiliate activities to ensure compliance with these terms.​

  • Violations: Any violation of these terms may result in immediate termination from the affiliate program, forfeiture of commissions, and potential legal action.​

  • Updates: Fromaggio may update these terms at any time. Affiliates will be notified of significant changes and are expected to comply promptly.​

By joining the Fromaggio Affiliate Program, you agree to abide by these terms and promote our products with integrity and authenticity. Let's work together to share the joy of homemade cheese with the world!

If you have any questions or need further clarification, please contact our affiliate support team at contact@fromaggio.com.
